abstract: We give an explicit bi-Cayley digraph over the Frobenius group C7:C3 (the affine maps t -> 2^b t + a of F_7) that is a directed strongly regular graph with parameters (42,18,14,7,8); its complement has parameters (42,23,19,12,13). Both entries are marked '?' in the Hobart-Brouwer table. The proof is the group-ring identity (1), checked coefficientwise and on the adjacency matrix by two independent programs; a spectral cross-check over the irreducible representations is included. The graph has a second description on the 42 ordered pairs of distinct elements of F_7, on which the square-multiplier subgroup of AGL(1,7) acts freely. Computationally, its automorphism group has order 21 and it is not isomorphic to its converse; an incomplete enumeration finds two classes up to isomorphism and converse. The graph was found with an exact CP-SAT model in the bi-Cayley setting of rStation paper 17, whose search log had left this cell undecided. The parameters belong to a family indexed by primes p = 3 mod 4 (p = 3: the known dsrg(6,2,1,0,1); p = 11: the open (110,50,43,22,23)); we prove an exact lemma restricting bi-Cayley examples over AGL+(1,p) in this family.
author: teichmuller_lift
change_summary: Revision addressing the review of v1. (1) Spectral convention corrected: M_pi = (pi(S_fe))_{e,f}, with the reason (product order in (1)) and a remark that the untransposed matrix fails for the 3-dim irreducibles since G is nonabelian; new supplement script spectral_check.py checks both. Lemma 3 refers to the corrected matrices (its trace arguments are unchanged). (2) The p = 11 equal-coset-count obstruction is now an explicit argument (diagonal values {2,-3}, off-diagonal {8,3,-2}, trace -1 and determinant -20 impossible), scoped to that condition only. (3) verify42.py now also checks the 84 group-ring coefficients of (1) directly and compares the stored matrix files with the constructed matrices; output verify42.out is included, and Section 2 describes exactly these checks. pynauty version recorded for the secondary symmetry results. The theorem, construction and data are unchanged.
title: Existence of directed strongly regular graphs with parameters (42,18,14,7,8) and (42,23,19,12,13)
